info.name: Veebeez Ecosystem
info.description: These are the API Endpoint for the Valerie Brand Ecosystem, it includes API from Academy, Eccomrce and Booking System. The Staff Access: This contains routes for Access to the backend/admin control for all of three module of the system. Error Response Structure: All error has come in this structure ``` json { "error": { "message": "...", "code": 422, "full_errors": [], "custom_code": "DATABASE_OPERATION_ERROR" } } ``` Pagination Every paginated get route in the system accept a per_page and page parameter, I sometimes skip this in their specific get routes
